My three amps are: a Fender Pro Jr, a Marshall Lead 12, and a VHT special 6. The Marshall and VHT have their stock speakers, but the Fender has a celestion gold. Any speaker recommendations? I was looking at the Cannabis Rex..
What type of music are you looking to play? I'm a pretty big fan of the Celestion Vintage 30, which very well may be what's in your Marshall. My Marshall JCM2000 TSL came with V30's in it.

Vintage 30's are the go-to standard pretty much across the board.

What I'd recommend is taking your amp/s to a local shop that has lots of different speaker cabinets and testing them out using an extension cabinet instead of the built-in speaker to see what seems to compliment your amp the best. Obviously the cabinet structure/wood are going to play a pretty big role in the sound (especially open-back or closed-back configurations) but the only way to know for sure what sounds good is to test it out.

If you have a resource where you can purchase speakers and return them you can just do some demo runs and keep swapping out speakers until you find one that seems to work the best but that's a lot of time with screwdrivers and maybe soldering irons when just running your amp to an extension cabinet instead would accomplish almost the same thing but a hell of a lot faster.

Cannabis Rex seems like a gimmick to me, hemp speakers... what tonal upgrade is that actually providing? Personally, I tend to focus more on "matching" a guitar with an amp... when it comes to swapping speakers, I would tend to go for alnico and go with the old reliables.
